Naomi —

Huge apologies for the sudden change but the building just issued a safety closure this morning. The conference center roof has been deemed hazardous after overnight ice accumulation; facilities has shut down events in the main hall until inspections finish. I'm attaching the official notice from building management. They expect an update within ~2 hours but couldn't guarantee clearance.

If they don't clear, we can either:
1) Move to the hotel ballroom (same block) but only two smaller boardrooms are available at executive table size; or
2) Convert to fully virtual for the exec briefing; or
3) Postpone until Friday morning if that works for Redwood and the exec team.

I'll loop venue operations on this thread — can you hold on final logistics for now?

Claire Hughes
Director, Strategic Accounts | SummitCorp
claire.hughes@summitcorp.com | +1 (408) 555-2210

Team — forwarding Claire's note. Building ops just posted the closure; Claire attached the safety notice. We need a quick decision on fallback so we can notify the execs and re-route travel if necessary. Options: hotel ballroom (limited capacity), hybrid (boardroom + virtual), or move to Friday AM. Thoughts on the following:

- I can still print agendas and be on-site if we move to the hotel (would need hotel-floorplan.png).
- Marcus, can your team spin up a secure meeting link (Zoom with registration + waiting room) in <30 min if we go virtual? We should also enable a one-time passcode for the exec panel.
- Monica, can you check travel for Marcus & me if we need to stay overnight or rebook Friday?

If we opt for hybrid, prioritize: secure stream (no sensitive data shared), a dedicated breakout for the CFO to join in-person, and 2 on-site Redwood staff.

Thanks — Naomi

Naomi / Monica —

Thanks for the heads up. If building ops can't clear the main hall within 2 hours I recommend we move to a hybrid plan that minimizes disruption:

1) Redwood will publish a locked Zoom meeting (registration required) and route incoming execs to the lobby boardroom for secure on-site presence. I can stand up the meeting and a second RTMP stream to the hotel AV system. Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/123456789 (will update with passcode).
2) We'll limit in-person attendance to the executive table (8 pax) — rest attend virtually. Naomi you'll print the 8 copy sets; I'll bring the audio bridge and test at 10am if we confirm the hotel.
3) If SummitCorp prefers postponing to Friday morning, Redwood is available but we should confirm travel/lodging adjustments now to avoid last-minute rebooking fees.

I'll prepare a short script for the start-of-briefing transparency note (e.g., "roof closure, hybrid for safety") and a slide with contingency notes.

- Redwood to provide two on-site staff (Naomi + Marcus) and the AV kit.
